blocks.title: Terms of use mein akhlaqi pehlu
blocks.text: Terms of use munsifana, shaffaf aur users ke huqooq ka ehtaram karne wali hon: wazeh aur seedhi, ghair zaroori pecheeda ya dhoke wali nahi, aur providers yaqeeni banayein ke users samajhte hain ke kis par raza de rahe hain.

Pakistan mein online course ko wazeh batana chahiye ke certificate milega ya nahi, zaati data kaise sambhala jayega aur koi izafi fees hain ya nahi; chhupi laagat ke bawajood course ko muft dikhana ghair akhlaqi hai.

blocks.prompt: Aham sharait ko bohat lambe document mein chhupana ghair akhlaqi kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Users aisi shiqon par soch samajh kar raza nahi de sakte jo woh aasani se dhoond ya samajh na sakein, to provider ko na-munsifana faida milta hai.

items: Akhlaqi shiqein wazeh, diyanatdar aur munsifana: chhupi laagat ya dabi sharait nahi.
